# Pull Request Template

## Summary

Describe the framework problem and the change made.

## Evidence and impact

Explain why this guidance is needed, who it affects, and any adoption implications.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is self-contained and linked from its parent document.
- [ ] Requirements use clear normative language where appropriate.
- [ ] No placeholders, unexplained TODOs, or empty structures were introduced.
- [ ] Links and Markdown rendering were verified.
